name: sales-playbook-section
description:
Produces one section of a sales playbook with talk tracks, common
scenarios, competitive differentiation, and handling guidance using
playbook format methodology. Use when the user asks to create a sales
playbook section, write a talk track for a specific sales scenario,
build competitive battle cards, document a sales play, or structure
guidance for a specific selling situation.
Do NOT use for full objection handling banks (use objection-handling),
discovery call scripts (use discovery-call-script), or sales training
curriculum (use teaching skills).
